extracted.intended_audience: editors of little magazines and small book presses worldwide (and Pushcart's contributing editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting up to six nominations of individual poems, stories, essays, memoirs, or stand-alone novel excerpts to the Pushcart Prize; covers who may nominate, eligible work types, submission window, physical submission requirements, and other procedural rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nomination limit
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome up to six nominations (print or online) from little magazine and small book press editors throughout the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each eligible editor may submit no more than six works total (in any combination of print or online items).

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may nominate
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominations are accepted from little magazine and small book press editors throughout the world. We also accept nominations from our staff of distinguished Contributing Editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only editors of qualifying small magazines/presses and Pushcart's contributing editors may submit nominations (no general open submissions from authors/public).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible genres and formats
rubrics_metrics.description: The nominations may be any combination of poetry, short stories, essays, memoirs or stand-alone excerpts from novels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pushcart accepts a broad range of literary forms; nominators may mix genres among their up-to-six submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations, reprints, and style accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: We welcome translations, reprints and both traditional and experimental writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translated works and pieces previously reprinted are eligible; experimental/formally nontraditional work is explicitly accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission period (postmark requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominations are accepted between October 1 - December 1 (postmarked) for next year's Pushcart edition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions must be postmarked within this window to be considered for the following year's edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: No email submissions; physical copies only
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not accept nominations via email. Please send one copy of each work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a single physical copy of each nominated work by mail; electronic/email submissions will not be accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not send entire books or journals
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not send entire books or journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only individual pieces should be mailed — do not mail whole books or full issues of journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: No returns
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All mailed materials become non-returnable; do not send items you expect back.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication-year eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominations must have been published (or scheduled to be published) in the current calendar year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible works are those published during the current calendar year or that are scheduled for publication within that same year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mailing address and contact info
rubrics_metrics.description: Mail to Pushcart Press, P.O. Box 380, Wainscott, NY 11975. Phone: 631.324.9300.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided postal address for sending physical nomination copies; phone number available for inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: No fee and no form required
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no entry fee and no form to fill out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominations are free and do not require a submission form — send only the single copy of each work per other guidelines.
